# 1.2.51 - what the table saw on 1.2.50

A second look at a live world before the README's screenshots, and two errors
that world threw. Nothing here asks a world to be migrated.

## Fixed

- **The Item tables window opens where it should and can be moved again.** Since
  1.2.44 its render stopped on a name one of its pieces never looked up, so the
  window sat pinned to the top left corner, could not be dragged, and a table
  could not be renamed or deleted from it.
- **Project tokens no longer throw at load.** The sync that puts projects on the
  map ran on the first scene draw, before the game was ready, and a project whose
  token had been deleted by hand stopped it there with "You may not set a
  World-level Setting before the Game is ready". It waits for the game now.

## On the map

- **Every student's token stands on a frame**, on every screen, the GM's
  included: the token's own square, which the isometric view draws as a diamond
  under the student's feet, in the hour's colour. **The token you play is framed
  in bone**, so you find it among the others at a glance. It replaces the circle
  that used to mark your own token alone.
- **A project's icon fits inside its frame** under Isometric Perspective. The
  picture stood upright over the diamond and ran out of it at the top and the
  bottom; it is drawn smaller now, and project tokens already on a map are
  resized the next time the GM loads the scene.
- **Foundry's selection is the interface colour.** The border of a selected
  token, tile, drawing, note, region or template, and the rectangle you drag to
  select, were Foundry's orange; they take the colour of the hour and the phase
  now, like the room borders and the frames. A wall's highlight and the resize
  handles keep Foundry's orange.

## For the GM

- **The GM panel's Next time of day button** stands at the end of the clock's
  line, or on the line under it when there is no room, instead of at the left
  edge of the window.
- **The players' names in the project manager lie flat**, a word to a line. With
  sixteen players the whole table, Edit and Delete included, fits the window on a
  1920 px screen.

## For everyone

- **A notice's text starts right under its title bar.** It used to float in the
  middle of a card grown to fill the notice tile.
- **The name of the track on the clock** has a note at each end, so it reads as
  a song rather than one more line of the clock.
- **A Hope or Despair Call that is shut for now** (by the Eclipse, or a Despair
  Call during a Class Trial) no longer shows an empty box in its top right
  corner. It was meant to be a padlock, drawn in a font Foundry v14 no longer
  loads; the tile is still dimmed and its tooltip says what it waits for.
- **The character sheet's Actions tab fits the sheet** under Stained Glass at
  any interface scale the screen has room for: at 80 % the last row of Hope Calls
  no longer hides under the frame.

275 regression tests pass on a live world.
